title: Use Flova AI’s Script Skill with Seedance 2.5 to turn a full story script/brief…
content:

Use Seedance 2.5’s 30-second generation length to produce complete, polished shots that can be assembled into a cinematic short.

Choose Seedance 2.5 Series (480p) for lower cost generation (from $0.025/sec) when budget is a priority.
